hypotheses: H1: Second-line activity is driven by lineage-specific target dependence (e.g., AR in PC3 vs MCF7, BTK in A375 vs HA1E), so choosing a line with the opposite target context maximizes discordance.
H2: Second-line activity is dominated by shared systematic response (S2) and vehicle-norm thresholds (S5), so any second line yields similar activity labels; discordance is mostly noise.

Target annotations (S4) are weaker than measured responses; tissue-specific target dependence not established.
Activity is a vehicle-norm threshold in L1000, not viability (S5); two labels do not establish mechanism.
Source choice matters (S1); database verification supports descriptions, not causal proof (S3).
